brief: patient records data table with selectable rows for a healthcare admin tool. Columns: checkbox, patient name, MRN, last visit (date), status badge, actions menu. Use sky-500 for the focus ring on the active row and emerald-600 for the 'active' status badge background. Header row is sticky. Pagination at the bottom right with page-N selector and page-size dropdown. Row hover state slightly tints the row background.
